01 / THE WORK AROUND THE MODEL

A harness is the execution system around a model: context, tools, workflow and checks, designed as one system.

A model gives you capability.
A harness makes it fit.

Different data. Different tools. Different definitions of “right”. We design these into a working system, rather than asking your business to adapt to a generic agent.

What goes into a harness
02 / WHERE WE START

Work worth getting right.

Start with a repeatable, data-intensive task whose outcome a person can evaluate. A fit for document- and data-intensive teams: procurement, supply chain, compliance and knowledge operations.

04 / A FOCUSED PILOT

One task.
A clear way to judge it.

Define the job and acceptance criteria first. Use the pilot to decide what deserves to scale.

01

A task-specific workflow

Inputs, tools, permissions and human review points.

02

An evaluation baseline

Representative samples, failure categories and checks.

03

A version improvement plan

Candidate tests, release decisions and rollback boundaries.

A typical pilot runs 4–6 weeks: one task, one document family, one acceptance standard. Proposed deliverables; final scope depends on the assessed scenario and agreement.
